title: Analytic: quarter-wave Bragg stack as an EME periodic block, Bloch phase and Chebyshev transmission (em_eme)
description:
One period of a quarter-wave Bragg stack (n_A = 1.5 / d_A = 250 nm, n_B = 2.5 / d_B = 150 nm, period 400 nm, n_A d_A = n_B d_B = 375 nm: Bragg wavelength 1.5 um) drawn once between 250 nm of vacuum on each side, em_eme along x (E_z, 25 nm cells, y-periodic strip of 200 nm, n_modes 0 = the complete basis of the 8-cell lines), an eme_periodic block over the drawn cell repeating it 6 times, so the device is vacuum | (A B)^6 | vacuum. Stationary solve, swept over lambda0 = 1.0-2.2 um (base 1.5 um, the last sweep value). The strip is uniform across y, so only the plane wave (mode 1, k_y = 0) is propagating and it couples to nothing else: the EME is exact up to rounding (continuum propagation along x, exact Fresnel interfaces, float32-exact eps 1, 2.25, 6.25).
Analytic (characteristic matrices, normal incidence): a = k0 n_A d_A, b = k0 n_B d_B; Bloch phase cos(K period) = t = cos a cos b - (n_A/n_B + n_B/n_A)/2 sin a sin b; attenuation Im K / k0 = -acosh(|t|) / (k0 period) in the stop band (|t| > 1), 0 in the pass bands (|lam| = exp(-acosh(max(|t|, 1))) per period); the 6-period stack in vacuum has M^6 = U_5(t) M - U_4(t) I (Chebyshev), so T = 1 / (T_6(t)^2 + U_5(t)^2 S^2 / 4), S = sin a cos b (n_A + 1/n_A) + cos a sin b (n_B + 1/n_B), R = 1 - T (lossless). At the Bragg wavelength t = -1.1333, Im K period = -ln(n_B / n_A), T = 1 / cosh(6 ln(5/3))^2 = 0.00867; stop band 1.292-1.788 um.
Derived values tab (lambda0 = 1.5 um): T_bragg (eme_transmission_1), R_bragg (eme_reflection), cos_K_period (from the Bloch table row 1: (lam + 1/lam)/2 = (|lam| + 1/|lam|)/2 cos(phase_per_period)), n_bloch_imag_1 and bloch_multiplier_1 (|lam|) vs their references.
Sweep tab: T_bragg, cos_K_period and bloch_multiplier_1 versus lambda0 with the dashed analytic curves (the stop band: T dips, cos(K period) < -1, |lam| < 1); n_bloch_imag_1 is compared per sweep value only (its reference is exactly 0 in the pass bands, where a per-point relative curve error would measure rounding noise).
Curves & tables: eme.stretch (eme_length_sweep over the drawn cell: every period stretched by 0.5-1.5 at 1.5 um, re-cascaded without a mode solve) transmission_1 / reflection versus the stretched period vs the dashed Chebyshev formula with a and b scaled by the stretch.
Expected agreement: ~1e-8 or better everywhere (rounding of the 8-mode cascade); tolerances 1e-5 (T, R, curves) and 1e-6 (Bloch values). Field tab: |E_z| of the first period and the field leaving the sixth.

parameters.name: n_A
parameters.description: index of layer A (eps 2.25)

parameters.name: n_B
parameters.description: index of layer B (eps 6.25)

parameters.name: d_A
parameters.description: thickness of layer A (10 cells)

parameters.name: d_B
parameters.description: thickness of layer B (6 cells); n_B d_B = n_A d_A (quarter-wave at 1.5 um)

parameters.name: Lam_cell
parameters.description: period of the stack (400 nm)

parameters.name: L_in
parameters.description: vacuum before the stack (input port medium)

parameters.name: L_out
parameters.description: vacuum after the stack (output port medium)

parameters.name: x_cell0
parameters.description: start of the drawn period (a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_cell1
parameters.description: end of the drawn period (a cell edge)

parameters.name: H_strip
parameters.description: y-periodic strip height (8 cells; y harmonics evanescent at every swept wavelength)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the stationary solve (swept 1.0-2.2 um, base = the Bragg wavelength)

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber [1/m]

parameters.name: a_ph
parameters.description: phase thickness of layer A [rad]

parameters.name: b_ph
parameters.description: phase thickness of layer B [rad]

parameters.name: t_bl
parameters.description: cos(K period): half the trace of the cell matrix

parameters.name: s_xy
parameters.description: sum of the off-diagonal cell matrix entries (imaginary parts) in vacuum units

parameters.name: cheb_T6
parameters.description: Chebyshev T_6(t) = half the trace of M^6 (written for n_periods = 6 of the grating feature)

parameters.name: cheb_U5
parameters.description: Chebyshev U_5(t)

parameters.name: T_ref
parameters.description: power transmission of vacuum | (A B)^6 | vacuum

parameters.name: mult_ref
parameters.description: |lam| per period of the decaying plane-wave Bloch mode (< 1 in the stop band, 1 in the pass bands)

parameters.name: alpha_ref
parameters.description: Im K / k0 of the plane-wave Bloch mode (< 0 in the stop band, 0 in the pass bands)
